sources.title: r/StableDiffusion on Reddit: MOSS LoRA training tips
sources.snippet: personally I gave up trying to get fizgig or ostris to run well (for the time being) and used this one I randomly found in a google search: https://github.com/suigin10/MOSS-LoRA-Trainer · I would prefer fizgig overall because the extra tooling is really nice, but the model had not learned anything by 1800 steps* and it was pretty slow (~90 minutes of warmup followed by 6s/it).
